newsitem.title: UK: UK bookmakers-no more byelection bets, May 4-9 fav.
newsitem.headline: UK bookmakers-no more byelection bets, May 4-9 fav.

text.p: British bookmakers William Hill said on Wednesday they had stopped taking bets on Labour winning the parliamentary by-election at Wirral South on February 27 and made Labour 1-4 favourite to win the next election.
William Hill said May remained 4-9 favourite as the month when the election would be called. March is rated 2-1 and April 5-1. The election must be held by May 22.

The Conservatives are 5-2 to win the election and the Liberal Democrats 500-1. Michael Portillo is 3-1 favourite to succeed Prime Minister John Major as Conservative party leader with Michael Howard 4-1 and Michael Heseltine 7-1.
